name: Agent Teams
description: Multi-member AI orchestration. Create teams, plan, approve, assign tasks, exchange messages and review quality across several AI workers.

name: Bob Preview
description: Render and interactively test web pages / mini programs on a real headless Chrome (CDP). Capture pixel screenshots that previously relied on DOM-to-SVG.

name: Bob Notes
description: Personal knowledge base (Karpathy-style LLM Wiki). Raw Inbox capture, AI compile, retrieval, review and backfill; backs the Kar node and notes panel.

name: Bob-Mind
description: Standalone mind-sticky library with its own panel and data dir. Tree-organized thoughts that you (and the AI via mind_* tools) capture and recall; independent from the canvas.

name: Bob OCR
description: Scanned-document and image recognition service (local Vision + GLM-OCR / Online OCR). Model & vendor settings live in the plugin itself — open Configure to manage them.

name: Bob Browser
description: Control your real, logged-in browser (53 browser.* tools) through a Chrome extension. Requires installing the standalone bob-browser-mcp daemon (port 9473) plus its extension.

name: Bobby node
description: Local desktop automation and grant-based app control (run commands, UI actions). Every action requires your authorization. Requires a local bobby-mcp build / global install.

name: GitHub
description: Manage GitHub repositories: issues, pull requests, code pushes and settings. Server package is pulled automatically via npx; requires a Personal Access Token.

name: Notion
description: Read and write Notion pages and databases you authorized. Server package is pulled automatically via npx; requires an Integration API Key.

name: Context7
description: Up-to-date documentation lookup for frameworks and libraries. Coding-only server; kept off for general chat to avoid schema noise. No API key needed.

name: Pkulaw · Legal Search
description: Semantic and keyword search over Chinese laws, regulations and cases with pkulaw.com source links. Requires a pkulaw API Key (guided on install).

name: Tianyancha · Business Data
description: Query Chinese company registry, risks, IP and filings. Requires a Tianyancha API Key (guided on install).
